name: CIL Securities Limited
about: CIL Securities Limited provides diversified financial services in India. The company offers online and offline securities trading services; equity research cell; merchant banking services; margin trading facility; equity valuation; registrar and share transfer agents services; depository participant, as well as distributes mutual funds services. It also provides broking services to retail, high net worth, and institutional clients. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Hyderabad, India.
